desc: Derive marginal-cost formula (unit j of product i costs (2j−1)·P_i) and greedy optimality.
Design counting/cost functions: k_i = (T//P_i + 1)//2, S(T) = Σ k_i²·P_i, C(T) = Σ k_i.
Design single binary search on T (largest T with S(T) ≤ M), answer = C(T) + (M − S(T)) // (T + 1); prove extra-units argument (cnt ≥ 1, enough products at marginal exactly T+1).
Determine bounds: lo = 0 (feasible), hi = 4·10**18 (infeasible since S(hi) ≫ M); ~62 iterations × O(N) with early exit is fast enough.
Check edge case M < min P_i (answer 0; maximality of T ensures correctness).

Implement final code (fast input parsing, early-exit cost check, binary search on T, final count/cost pass) and verify logic against samples (sample 1 traced by hand → 3; sample 2 → 53 per the algorithm's structure).
